title: tk-json-manifest's hosts section could state which commands a cannot_run_tk host may omit
body: hosts.cannot_run_tk says such a host "performs ONLY the reads and controlled writes listed below", which reads as an obligation to implement all of them; but `version` is a property of a binary that host does not run, `status` is a working-tree porcelain it has no tree for, and the merge drivers need a worktree. The z23 TypeScript client documents these three as deliberate non-implementations; a sentence in the manifest's hosts section (or per-entry notes) would make that an agreed contract rather than a consumer's judgement call.
